lines.zh: 爪下焦土冒烟，我缓步走过。
lines.en: Scorched earth smokes under my paws as I pad along.

lines.zh: 尾焰扫过草丛，一路燃着。
lines.en: My tail flame sweeps the grass and leaves a burning trail.

lines.zh: 我伏在岩缝里，火压得很低。
lines.en: I lie in a rock crevice with my fire kept low.
Patiently waiting for the right moment
My hide burns like living flame.
The flame tiger's eyes stick to you.

lines.zh: 你拔刀的手，被我的火光照亮。
lines.en: My firelight catches the hand drawing your blade.

lines.zh: 炎虎的鬃毛先烧了起来。
lines.en: The flame tiger's mane ignites first.

lines.zh: 我抬起鼻头，火舌卷向你。
lines.en: I lift my muzzle and flame licks toward you.
Flame wraps me — even the blood burns dry.

lines.zh: 焦黑的皮毛下，伤口在冒烟。
lines.en: Under my scorched fur, the wound smokes.
Flames dance, temptation hard to resist.

lines.zh: 火焰在它身上熊熊燃烧
lines.en: Flames burn fiercely on its body
It roars to warn you to stay away
Its tough hide is scorched by flames
It licks its wounds with flames

lines.zh: 炙热的气息从它口中喷出
lines.en: Hot breath escapes from its mouth

lines.zh: 火焰从它的爪子中喷出

lines.en: It spits flames at its enemies

lines.zh: 它舔食火焰以强化自己
lines.en: It licks flames to strengthen itself

lines.zh: 火焰环绕着它的身体旋转
你的气味引起了它的注意

lines.en: It locks on and begins to track
It prepares to consume you with flames
Its eyes are fixed on you

lines.zh: 火焰在它的视线中燃烧

lines.en: It prepares to burn you with flames

lines.zh: 你的气味，我隔着林火也闻到。
lines.en: I smell you even through the forest fire.

lines.zh: 皮毛一抖，火星四散，我来了。
lines.en: I shake my coat, sparks fly, and I come.
You stepped on my scorched ground.

lines.zh: 我伏低身子，火焰贴地窜。
lines.en: I crouch low and fire runs along the ground.

lines.zh: 你的影子被我烧在地上。
lines.en: Your shadow is burned into the ground.

lines.zh: 闻到你，我喉咙里的火就亮了。
lines.en: One scent of you and the fire in my throat ignites.

lines.zh: 瞄准你的弱点进行攻击
lines.en: Target your weak points for attack

lines.zh: 它用火焰吞噬你的防御
lines.en: It consumes your defenses with flames
Its claws are ready to tear you apart

lines.zh: 火焰准备从它的口中喷出
lines.en: Flames prepare to burst from its mouth

lines.zh: 它准备用火焰将你吞噬
lines.en: It prepares to consume you with flames

lines.zh: 火焰在它的爪子上闪烁

lines.en: It prepares to burn you to ashes

lines.zh: 火焰准备吞噬你的灵魂
lines.en: Flames prepare to consume your soul

lines.zh: 我围着你走，草一圈圈焦。
lines.en: I circle you and the grass chars in rings.

lines.zh: 火从四边起，你站在中央。
lines.en: Fire rises on four sides and you stand between.

lines.zh: 我压低喉咙，焰光透出齿缝。
lines.en: I lower my growl and flame seeps through my teeth.
You step back and the fire follows.

lines.zh: 我把爪子按进土里，火星上窜。
lines.en: I press my paws down and sparks leap up.

lines.zh: 热气扭曲了你眼前的景。
lines.en: The heat warps everything you see.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴一甩，火墙合拢。
lines.en: One tail swing and the fire wall closes.
I am inside the smoke; you are outside it.
Don't look up; the fire falls from above.
Hear that? My breathing is burning.

lines.zh: 我的鬃毛烧成一圈，罩住你。
lines.en: My mane burns into a ring and closes over you.

lines.zh: 火爪按住你，皮毛贴上来。
lines.en: My burning paw pins you, coat pressed close.
One bite and smoke leaks between my teeth.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫过，你衣服烧起来。
lines.en: My tail sweeps by and your clothes catch.

lines.zh: 我撞上去，火花溅了满地。
lines.en: I slam into you and sparks scatter everywhere.

lines.zh: 喉咙里的火，一口气喷出。
lines.en: The fire in my throat leaves in one breath.
My paw crosses you and leaves a scorch mark.
The burn comes first; the pain comes after.
This pounce drags a whole sheet of flame.
My teeth are hot to the touch.

lines.zh: 你身上有烤肉的味道了。
lines.en: You are starting to smell like roast meat.

lines.zh: 别躲，火追的是你的气味。
lines.en: Don't dodge; the fire tracks your scent.

lines.zh: 林间先亮了一下，我才出现。
lines.en: The woods flashed, then I appeared.

lines.zh: 一团火滚过，落地成了虎。
lines.en: A ball of fire rolled past and landed as a tiger.

lines.zh: 我从崖边跌落，火散了一路。
lines.en: I fall from the cliff edge, trailing fire.

lines.zh: 火烤的很疼，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: It burns! — and the starvation makes it worse.
